global _start
section .text
_start:
    ; open(path, O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC)
    mov rax, 2
    lea rdi, [rel path]
    mov rsi, 1
    syscall
    cmp rax, 0
    jl exit
    mov r8, rax
    ; write(fd, 'x', 1)
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, r8
    lea rsi, [rel payload]
    mov rdx, 1
    syscall
exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
path db '/etc/hosts', 0
payload db 'x'
